During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] maintained an '''Imperial Communications Center''' just outside the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Takari]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iyuta]]. It was built over an extensive sewer system that was home to tentacled monsters and scaly [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]].<ref name="Plant" /> 

[[General/Legends|General]] [[Lens Reekeene]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] sent [[Green squad]] to place a [[Listening device/Legends|listening device]] under the facility.<ref name="Plant" /> Sometime later, Green squad were tasked with monitoring communications from the facility using an experimental [[long-range scanner/decoder]]. During the assignment, Green squad discovered that [[Lens Reekeene]] had been captured by the Empire and abandoned their mission to [[Rescue of Lens Reekeene|rescue]] her.<ref name="Missing">{{WEGCite|story=Lens Reekeene Is Missing|book=Star Wars Campaign Pack}}</ref>
